title: A game state machine
hints: switch (state.mode) with one case per mode. Each case looks at event.type and returns a new object, or the same state.
Scoring: const score = state.score + event.points; return { ...state, score, level: 1 + Math.floor(score / 100) };
A hit: const lives = state.lives - 1; return { ...state, lives, mode: lives <= 0 ? "over" : "playing" };
